versions.content: A single RteInitializationRunnableBatch con- tainer may not handle RTEEvent s of different partitions All RTEEvent s mapped to a RteInitializationRunnableBatch container shall only trigger RunnableEntity s belonging to the same partition.

A single RteInitializationRunnableBatch con- tainer may not handle RTEEvent s of different partitions All RTEEvent s mapped to a RteInitializationRunnableBatch container may only trigger RunnableEntity s belonging to partitions of the same core.
